Turning to individual holdings, no single security shall exceed 2% of net asset value.

Aggregate exposure to any single issuer, including all securities of that issuer, shall not exceed 3.5% of net asset value, and for this purpose the securities of subsidiaries and of entities whose obligations the issuer guarantees are aggregated with those of the issuer itself.
Within the Private placement sleeve, no single security shall exceed 5% of net asset value.
Exposure to the Energy sector shall not exceed 15% of net asset value.
Exposure to the Utilities sector shall not exceed 20% of net asset value.
Exposure to issuers domiciled in United Kingdom shall not exceed 30% of net asset value.
Exposure to issuers domiciled in Italy shall not exceed 10% of net asset value.
No security of an issuer appearing on the Firm's Restricted List may be purchased or added to under any circumstances.
Issuers involved in the production of controversial weapons (cluster munitions, anti-personnel mines, biological and chemical weapons) are excluded absolutely.
Issuers deriving more than 20% of revenue from thermal coal are excluded.
carve_out: A security of an issuer above the 20% thermal coal revenue threshold may still be held where that specific security is a certified green bond (certified under a recognised green bond standard, with an external verification report held by Compliance) whose proceeds are contractually ring-fenced for transition projects; the qualification attaches to the individual security only and other securities of the same issuer remain excluded.

quote: Issuers assessed as being in breach of the UN Global Compact principles are excluded.
Derivatives that increase market exposure are prohibited. A derivative is treated as non-hedging where it is not matched to an identified risk in the portfolio that it reduces.
Gross notional exposure through derivatives | Shall not exceed 50% of net asset value | Sum of the absolute notional amounts of all open derivative positions

Mark-to-market exposure to any single derivatives counterparty | Shall not exceed 10% of net asset value | Net positive replacement value with that counterparty after netting under an enforceable master agreement
Uncollateralised derivatives exposure | Shall not exceed 5% of net asset value | Net positive replacement value across all counterparties that is not covered by collateral actually received and held
Derivatives may only be transacted with counterparties rated A- or better by at least one recognised rating agency.

threshold: executed master agreement including collateral annex before any trade
quote: Every derivatives counterparty must have executed a master agreement with the Fund, including a collateral annex, before any trade is executed.
Positions held in odd lots shall be valued using odd-lot prices; institutional round-lot prices shall not be applied to odd-lot positions.

threshold: prior approval of the Valuation Committee
quote: Any mark applied to a Level 3 asset requires prior approval of the Valuation Committee.
A price that has not been updated for more than 5 business days is deemed stale and must be referred to the Valuation Committee before use.
Holdings classified as illiquid shall not exceed 10% of net asset value.
At least 70% of net asset value shall be realisable within 5 business days under normal market conditions.
No single position shall require more than 5 business days to liquidate at 25% of average daily volume.
Swing pricing shall be applied on any dealing day on which net flows exceed 0.75% of net asset value.
